checkedAgainst: support.claude.com help center articles and the Claude release notes page, read on 2026-10-26; menu paths quoted as the articles give them
intro: As of the date above. The habits don't move. Only the buttons do. If what you see on your screen doesn't match a row, tell us; that's how this page stays current.

rows.whereToday: Two names for the same place. Web app: Settings > Your Claude. Desktop app: Settings > Memory. Toggles: "Search and reference chats", "Generate memory from chats", and "Include sensitive topics in memory" (off by default); import and export memory. Pausing keeps what's saved and stops new entries; "Reset memory" deletes everything and can't be undone.
rows.wasCalled: Settings > Memory with "Generate memory from chats" was the original layout; the desktop app still shows it (Oct 30, 2026). Some Team and Enterprise organizations see an older version under Settings > Capabilities.
rows.plans: On by default for Free, Pro, and Max. Team and Enterprise owners decide; off for each member until they turn it on.
rows.lastChanged: 2026-08-25 (memory works across chat and Cowork; entries editable under Topics; sensitive-topics setting added)

rows.thing: See, change, or delete what it remembers
rows.whereToday: Web: Settings > Your Claude, then "Manage" next to "Your memory". Desktop app: Settings > Memory, scroll to You (Preferences, Profile) and Topics. Open an entry to read it, use the edit icon to change it, or Delete. You can also tell it in chat to remember, change, or forget something.
rows.wasCalled: A single daily memory summary, not individual entries (before 2026-07-10).
rows.lastChanged: 2026-07-10 (individual categorized entries replaced the daily summary)

rows.thing: Keep one conversation out of memory
rows.whereToday: Click "+" in the message box and turn off "Memory" before sending the first message (on mobile, the switch is in the "+" menu). Or start an incognito chat, available on all plans.

rows.thing: Keep a project's memory separate from your account memory
rows.whereToday: On the project's page, under "Memory", turn off "Use account memory".

rows.thing: Upload, turn on, or remove a skill
rows.whereToday: Customize > Skills. To upload: "+", then "+ Create skill", then "Upload a skill". Package the skill folder as a ZIP; the folder must contain a skill.md file and the folder name must match the skill name. Toggle next to a skill turns it on or off; open a skill and use "..." to delete it. Code execution must be on (Settings > Capabilities on Free, Pro, and Max).
rows.plans: Custom skills upload on Free, Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise. Team and Enterprise sharing depends on owner settings.
rows.lastChanged: 2026-08-06 (skill and plugin security scanning, Enterprise beta)

rows.whereToday: No command. It uses enabled skills when it judges them relevant, from the skill's description. To make it reliable, name the skill in your request: "Use my brand guidelines skill to make a one-pager."

In the current experience there is no toggle; it searches the web when it judges that helpful. Older layout: "+" in the lower-left of the chat window, then "Web search" (a checkmark shows it's on). Team and Enterprise: an owner must enable web search first under Organization settings > Capabilities.
rows.wasCalled: A per-chat toggle under the "+" button.
rows.plans: Free accounts and paid plans; Team and Enterprise after the owner enables it.

rows.thing: Which model you're talking to, and how to change it
rows.whereToday: The model name and effort level appear next to the send button. Click the model name to change it; "More models" shows the rest. Changes apply from the next response.
rows.plans: All plans; Enterprise admins may limit models or set the default for new chats.
rows.lastChanged: 2026-10-07 (Haiku 5.5 added; the 5.5 family: Opus 5.5 on 2026-09-22, Sonnet 5.5 on 2026-09-28)

rows.whereToday: Click the model name, then "Effort": Low, Medium, High, Extra high, Max. Each model has a recommended level marked "Default". Thinking is separate: hover "Effort" and toggle "Thinking". On Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1, and Opus 5, thinking can't be turned off.
rows.wasCalled: "Extended thinking", a single toggle in the model menu (still how it appears for older models).

rows.whereToday: Haiku 5.5 (Oct 7, 2026; smallest and fastest), Sonnet 5.5 (Sep 28), Opus 5.5 (Sep 22), Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 (Sep 1). Older models still listed: Opus 5, Sonnet 5, Fable 5, Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.6.
rows.plans: Availability varies by plan; the model menu shows what your plan has.

rows.thing: Where the things it makes for you go (artifacts, docs, slides, designs)
rows.whereToday: Made in any conversation; no mode to choose. Artifacts are available on all plans. Claude Docs and Claude Slides are their own types.
rows.wasCalled: Artifacts were a paid feature; design and deck creation lived in Cowork.

rows.thing: Names that no longer appear: Cowork
rows.whereToday: Cowork's capabilities (longer multi-step work, file handling, tasks that keep running while you're away) work in any conversation without choosing a mode. There is no separate Cowork to open. An article that tells you to open Cowork is from before September 16, 2026.
rows.wasCalled: Cowork (a mode, then an app surface on desktop, web, and mobile).
rows.plans: Rolled out to Pro and Max first.

rows.thing: A new name you may meet: Duet
rows.whereToday: A research preview for Pro and Max: a separate app where Claude works as a proactive agent. It uses the same search and memory settings as the main app. Not needed for anything on this site.
